question: What authority and rewards does the goddess confer in relation to sacred pilgrimage sites?
premises: The goddess is mistress of the king of holy places.
The goddess grants the fruit of holy places.
The goddess grants the merit of gifts at holy places.
inference: She presides over sacred sites and dispenses the spiritual rewards associated with pilgrimage and giving there.
plain_english: She is mistress of the foremost holy place, grants the fruit of holy places, and gives the merit of gifts made there.
